$comment: Bytes per platform for `expo export --source-maps` output: Hermes bytecode bundle, bundled code assets (fonts, images) and the .clxi lexicon index on its own line. Raise only with a reason in the PR (mobile-engineer + devops-sre). Baseline 2026-10-03 at SDK 57 with the lexicon loader: android 3,214,516 B bundle + 989,294 B assets; ios 3,030,524 B bundle + 23,136 B assets; lexicon global-ranked.f1 (1,501 forms) 283,672 B on both. Bundle limits raised 2026-10-06 for E-1.5 S1 (Skia board, about 454 KB of bytecode per platform), approved by the product owner in session: S1 baseline android 3,762,936 B, ios 3,580,028 B, limits about 15 % above it; asset limits are about 15 % above the 2026-10-03 baseline; lexiconBytes is the absolute cap of the lexicon-index note §5.1 size gate (550,000 B at any form count, f1 or f0; restated 2026-10-04 in sprint 3 P7, which adds 215 B/form and a 2,550-form ceiling for f1 on the lexicon side and the f0 switch rule), which prepare:lexicon also enforces. Details: docs/architecture/notes/mobile-app-foundation.md §6.
